title: [Get_newspaper_header]Transnistrian Martial Law
desc:
It seems that Ukrainian nationalists, who almost destroyed Romania's puppet state of Transnistria a few years ago, have now successfully killed the local military governor with explosives planted in his car.

Reports have already begun to emerge that local partisans have seized power on the border region near the Hetmanate - Mohyliv, formed a provisional government - the "Council" or "Rada" - and declared that they will fight until the Romanian administration is completely expelled from the region.

Romania, in turn,declared martial law in Transnistria, sent its troops to Odesa and other areas to weaken the rebels as much as possible.German forces are also participating in clearing the region of insurgents.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Ukrainian Rebels Win in Transnistria
desc:
Unexpectedly for international observers, Ukrainian rebels won the Transnistrian Civil War. Despite military support from the Reich and Romania, the German military garrison in Odesa collapsed, as the last forces hostile to the Ukrainian population were cleared out of the city. It can now be said with certainty: "Odesa is Ukraian".

The Kingdom of Romania may now face a protracted political crisis, while the Greater Germanic Reich has declared that it does not recognize the statehood of the so-called "Dniester and Bug Administration" and demands from the Ukrainian Hetmanate "respect the borders established at the end of World War II".

Official Kyiv has refrained from commenting on the current situation and stated that "the population of the region has chosen a future in the Ukrainian Hetmanate, rather than oppression and political persecution in the Kingdom of Romania".

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the German Garrison in the Transnistria
desc:
Official communiques from Bucharest have confirmed what most have suspected for a while after collapse of Transnistrian government as the Romanian government has announced its evacuation of the Transnistrian territory.International observers were not surprised by the reasons for this, as it was the result of a violent and uncontrolled uprising by the Ukrainian population in the region.

The future of the former governorate is that of further Reich control as Romania transfers its responsibilities to the German administration, ruled under the control of military man Siegfried Haß.Siegfried has already announced the start of "cleansing the region of disloyal elements by force of arms", which in reality means the total end of Ukrainian ambitions to control the Odesa region.

Officially, Kyiv, under the guise of "helping to restore stability", annexed a region that belonged entirely to the rebels at the start of the conflict. The Reich remains silent on this issue.
